ops.title: review store: heal pre-attestation exact-v1 DBs instead of rejecting
ops.description: Any review-v1.db initialized before the attestation commits (51a0ffa/a9bb606/3b5793b, released v12.17.0) has user_version=1 but no cc_transcript_schema_v1 marker (23/24 objects) and possibly the candidates DEFAULT-1 textual drift; the exact-v1 validator rejects it with no remedy, killing 'review status' and silently killing announce_pr_status on every SessionStart. Ship a one-shot heal (marker graft + writable_schema text patch, as in note d0463f7) or an explicit 'capt-hook review heal' command. Repro + recipe: note d0463f7.

ops.text: A review-v1.db initialized pre-attestation (user_version=1, no cc_transcript_schema_v1 marker) opens successfully on 12.20.x — or fails loudly with a named remedy — with candidates/verdicts/feedback preserved
announce_pr_status no longer swallows store-open errors silently
